cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: You Could at Least…
cards.instruction: Make the inconvenience visible enough that an apology becomes the easiest way forward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Here's the bus timetable. I circled every bus I missed waiting for you to return my keys.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Three circles. And here's the takeaway receipt from when my dinner was still hot.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll buy another dinner. Can we put the papers away?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep your money. Say you're sorry, and we can clear the table instead of reconstructing my evening.

mechanism: A presides over visible evidence of inconvenience and grants closure only after an apology rather than compensation.
confusable: Ordinary compensation bargaining seeks payment; D27 wants the visible disruption to make an apology easiest, under A approval.
comparison: A documentary reconstruction of delay differs from the wet-sock scene immediate intrusion at dinner.
seedUse: Use D27-b timetable and receipt, with S01 rulings governing when the complaint display may be cleared.
